tailoring.headline: Techno-Functional E-Commerce Consultant | SAP Commerce Cloud & Integration Expert
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years delivering enterprise e-commerce platforms on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, REST/OCC APIs, data-pipeline integration between PIM, ERP and MDM, and performance-tuned SQL. Proven techno-functional consulting: analysing requirements, crafting user stories, and guiding international teams through design, implementation and production support, utilizing AI-assisted tools for rapid documentation and testing.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Consultant für Ecommerce
cover_en.hook: I am excited by antegma’s focus on delivering cutting-edge e-commerce solutions for leading brands. With over five years of designing, integrating and supporting SAP Commerce Cloud platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise in end-to-end e-commerce architecture that aligns with your consultancy needs.

bullets.label: **Integration Expertise**
bullets.text: At Rockwell Automation I designed and built PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines and resolved ERP/MDM integration bottlenecks, delivering seamless product catalog synchronization across global channels.

bullets.label: **API & Headless Commerce**
bullets.text: I developed OCC REST web services and headless APIs for storefronts and third-party consumers, enabling flexible front-end integrations similar to Adobe Commerce Cloud requirements.

bullets.label: **Techno-Functional Consulting**
bullets.text: I worked directly with business stakeholders to analyse requirements, write user stories and functional specifications, and translate them into robust SAP Commerce solutions, ensuring alignment with business goals.

bullets.label: **Agile Delivery & DevOps**
bullets.text: I executed CI/CD deployment cycles on SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2) and led performance-tuning of SQL queries, supporting production stability and rapid releases.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, I hold a valid German residence and work permit, am serving notice until 15 December 2026 and can start on 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute to antegma.

cover_de.subject: Bewerbung als Consultant für Ecommerce
cover_de.hook: Die Möglichkeit, bei antegma innovative E-Commerce-Lösungen für namhafte Kunden zu realisieren, begeistert mich. Mit über fünf Jahren Erfahrung in der Konzeption, Integration und dem Betrieb von SAP Commerce Cloud-Plattformen bei Rockwell Automation und Shell bringe ich fundiertes Fachwissen in End-to-End-E-Commerce-Architekturen mit, das optimal zu Ihrem Beratungsansatz passt.

bullets.label: **Integrationsexpertise**
bullets.text: Bei Rockwell Automation habe ich PIM-zu-Hybris Datenpipelines entwickelt und ERP/MDM-Integrationsengpässe behoben, wodurch eine nahtlose Synchronisation der Produktkataloge über globale Kanäle gewährleistet wurde.

bullets.label: **API & Headless Commerce**
bullets.text: Ich habe OCC-REST-Webservices und Headless-APIs für Storefronts und Drittanbieter entwickelt, was flexible Front-End-Integrationen ermöglicht – ein direkter Mehrwert für Adobe Commerce-Projekte.

bullets.label: **Techno-funktionale Beratung**
bullets.text: In enger Zusammenarbeit mit Fachbereichen habe ich Anforderungen analysiert, User Stories und funktionale Spezifikationen erstellt und in robuste SAP-Commerce-Lösungen überführt, stets im Sinne der Geschäftsziele.

bullets.label: **Agile Lieferung & DevOps**
bullets.text: Ich habe CI/CD-Deployments auf der SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2) durchgeführt und SQL-Abfragen performance-optimiert, um Produktionsstabilität und schnelle Release-Zyklen sicherzustellen.

cover_de.logistics: Ich lebe in Karlsruhe, besitze eine gültige deutsche Aufenthaltserlaubnis, befinde mich in der Kündigungsfrist bis zum 15.12.2026 und kann ab dem 16.12.2026 starten. Ich freue mich auf ein Gespräch, um meinen Beitrag zu antegma zu erläutern.

tailoring.why_company: antegma’s reputation for crafting tailored e-commerce ecosystems for top-tier brands aligns perfectly with my passion for delivering high-impact, integration-focused solutions. I am impressed by your commitment to innovative technology stacks and collaborative consulting, and I see a strong fit for my SAP Commerce Cloud expertise to help expand your Magento-related service portfolio.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to join antegma to apply my SAP Commerce Cloud integration expertise in a consultancy that drives cutting-edge e-commerce solutions for leading brands.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud developer with 5+ years of integration experience. I’m eager to discuss how I can help antegma deliver top-tier e-commerce solutions. Let’s connect!
tailoring.email_body: Dear Hiring Team, please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Consultant für Ecommerce position at antegma. I bring over five years of SAP Commerce Cloud experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell, with strong integration and consulting skills. I look forward to discussing how I can add value to your projects.
